test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Three statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements. 

**Statements:**

All dahlias are lilies.

All sunflowers are lilies.

Some dahlias are hibiscus.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some sunflowers are not dahlias.

II. Some hibiscuses are not lilies.

III. Some lilies are hibiscus.

options.text: Both conclusion II and III follow.
Both conclusion I and III follow.

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ef56002e0d757b60fc13bcdb7d1366b52dcda64d077fed7fcba4467edf4c3421.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some sunflowers are not dahlias → Does not follow (As all dahlias are lilies and all sunflowers are lilies. As no direct relation is given dahlias and sunflowers, therefore it is false)

II. Some hibiscuses are not lilies → Does not follow (As all dahlias are lilies and some dahlias are hibiscus. As no direct relation is given hibiscus and lilies, therefore it is false)

III. Some lilies are hibiscus → Follow (As all dahlias are lilies and some dahlias are hibiscus. As some part of hibiscus is common with dahlias which whole comes in lilies, therefore it is true.)

∴ Here, Only conclusion III follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1"
